reference: 用户提供的今天页设计图，2026-10-01
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single transparent portrait composition for the Today page of the ZhouJi iPhone app.
Reference image: the attached phone design is the exact composition and print style reference. Recreate ONLY the illustration inside the screen, no phone, no text, no interface.
Primary request: Match the illustration in the reference closely, in vintage silkscreen poster and hand-drawn FLAT illustration style. A tall dark moss-green rectangular two-pane window sits HIGH on the upper RIGHT, a flat mustard sun in its upper pane and simple moss green city silhouettes in its lower pane. A small leafy houseplant in a terracotta pot enters from the LEFT edge at mid height. The cheerful round durian mascot sits at the CENTER LOWER area behind a broad terracotta desk, with olive green spiky shell, pale buttery yellow round face, tiny black dot eyes, small curved smile, warm peach blush, short brown stem and bold uneven dark brown outline, tiny hands holding a pencil over an open cream journal; a cream mug with a green heart sits to the right, a blue green chair behind. The desk extends beyond both left and right canvas edges and its lower edge is softly uneven printed ink.
Composition: portrait canvas width:height approximately 5:6. The window occupies x=55%-100%, y=2%-55%. Mascot occupies x=28%-76%, y=43%-85%. Plant occupies x=0%-30%, y=41%-87%. Open book x=15%-65%, y=78%-93%. Mug x=67%-84%, y=73%-89%. Terracotta desk ink at y=80%-100% across full width. Leave the upper LEFT x=0%-51%, y=0%-42% genuinely transparent and empty, for editable greeting/date/copy later. Artwork reaches side edges without padding. Enlarge the window vertically to match reference, avoiding the horizontal sticker-card arrangement of the previous app.
Style: flat limited spot colors, irregular hand drawn contours, vintage 1960s screen printed children's-book poster, coarse ink speckle and scraped ink holes INSIDE printed shapes, matte ink, warm muted moss green and olive, cream yellow, terracotta, charcoal brown. Slight handmade registration irregularity. Shape design and character identity closely match the reference. Uniform roughness, simple planar solids.
Background: real transparent alpha outside the illustration. The WINDOW PANES are flat warm cream paper-like fills with subtle grain. No opaque whole-page background. No gradient, glow, blurry perimeter or shadow vignette; no realistic rendering, no 3D, no watercolor wash.
Constraints: no letters, no words, no greeting, no date, no plus sign, no buttons, no navigation icons, no phone frame, no label. Return just this one ready-to-use transparent illustration.
